content: Maria fui mina morin ba Nai Jesus nia ain
Falta loron neen atu tama ba festa Paskua, Jesus too iha Betánia, Lázaro nia aldeia. Lázaro nee mak foin lalais Jesus halo moris fali husi mate.
Ema iha fatin nee prepara hahaan kalan nian hodi simu Jesus. Marta serve iha meza, i Lázaro tuur iha meza ho bainaka sira seluk hodi haan hamutuk ho Jesus.
Depois Maria mai lori mina morin folin karun teb-tebes litru sorin. Nia fui mina morin nee ba iha Jesus nia ain, depois hamaran ho nia fuuk. Nunee uma laran tomak morin hotu.
Maibee Judas Iscariotes, Jesus nia eskolante ida nebee sei faan Jesus dehan,
“Nusaa mak nia la faan mina morin nee, depois nia osan foo ba ema kiak sira? Tanba mina nee folin karun, hanesan ema badaen nia salariu ba tinan ida tomak.”

Judas hatete nunee laos tanba nia interese ba ema kiak maibee tanba nia naok-teen ida. Nia mak toma konta Jesus ho Nia eskolante sira nia osan, maibee nia gosta foti osan balu husi kofre ba nia aan rasik.
Jesus hataan, “Keta hirus nia! Tanba nia prepara mina morin nee atu hamorin Hau nia isin para hakoi.
Ema kiak sira sempre iha imi nia leet, maibee Hau laos atu hela nafatin ho imi.”
Nai lulik nia ulun sira hakarak oho Lázaro
Ema Judeu barak rona katak Jesus iha Betánia hela, nunee sira mos baa iha nebaa. Sira baa laos atu haree deit Jesus, maibee sira mos hakarak haree Lázaro tanba Jesus halo moris fali nia husi mate.
Nunee nai lulik nia ulun sira halo planu atu oho hotu Lázaro,
tanba nia istoria nee halo ema Judeu barak husik tiha nai lulik sira hodi fiar ba Jesus.
Ema barak haklalak simu Nai Jesus tama iha Jerusalém
Aban fali ema barak nebee too uluk ona iha Jerusalém atu tuir festa Paskua rona katak Jesus iha hela dalan atu baa iha nebaa.
Nunee sira foti ramus hodi baa simu Nia. Sira haklalak hahii Maromak dehan,

content.text: Nai Maromak foo bensaun ba Ida nebee mak mai hodi Maromak nia naran.
Maromak foo bensaun ba ema Israel sira nia Liurai.”

content: Jesus hetan kuda buru oan ida, i Nia sae kuda buru nee. Nunee Nia halo tuir buat nebee hakerek iha Livru Sagradu dehan,

content.text: Haree ba, imi nia Liurai mai,

content: Iha tempu nebaa Jesus nia eskolante sira la kompriende saida mak akontese nee. Bainhira Maromak foti aas Jesus foin sira kompriende katak, buat nebee sira halo nee hakerek nanis ona iha Livru Sagradu.
Ema barak nebee uluk haree Jesus bolu Lázaro sai husi rate hodi halo moris fali nia, sira konta nafatin istoria nee ba ema seluk.
Nee mak ema barak sai baa hodi simu Jesus, tanba sira rona katak Nia halo ona milagre ida nee.
Entaun ema Farizeu sira hatete ba malu dehan, “Ita la bele halo buat ida ona. Haree took, ema iha mundu tomak halai hotu ba Nia!”
Nai Jesus koalia kona ba Nia mate
Husi ema barak nebee mak baa iha Jerusalém atu adora Maromak iha festa Paskua nee, balu ema Gregu, laos ema Judeu.
Sira baa hasoru malu ho Filipe husi aldeia Betsaida, provinsia Galileia hodi husu, “Senhor, ami hakarak hasoru malu ho Jesus.”
Depois Filipe hatete ba André, i sira nain rua baa foo hatene Jesus.
Jesus dehan, “Tempu too ona atu Maromak foti aas Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan.
Hau hatete lo-loos ba imi, se trigu fini ida la kuda ba rai i mate, nia nafatin musan ida deit. Fini nee mate mak foin foo fali trigu musan barak.
Ema nebee hadomi liu nia moris iha mundu nee, sei lakon fali nia moris. Maibee see mak tau nia moris nee iha kotuk fali, nia sei hetan moris rohan-laek.
Ema nebee halao Hau nia servisu, nia tenki tuir Hau. Nunee Hau iha nebee deit, nia mos hamutuk ho Hau. I Hau nia Aman sei respeita nia.
Agora Hau nia laran susar. Hau atu dehan saida? Hau atu husu Hau nia Aman hasai Hau husi tempu terus nee ka? Lae. Hau la bele husu nunee, tanba Hau mai iha mundu atu hetan terus nee duni.
Nee mak Hau husu dehan, ‘Hau nia Aman, foti aas Ita Boot nia naran ba!’ ” Derepenti iha lian ida husi lalehan dehan, “Hau foti aas tiha ona Hau nia naran, i Hau sei foti aas fali tan.”
Ema barak nebee hamriik iha nebaa rona lian nee. Balu dehan rai tarutu. Balu tan dehan Maromak nia anju ida koalia ho Jesus.
Jesus dehan, “Lian nebee imi rona nee laos atu tulun Hau, maibee atu tulun imi.
Agora tempu too ona atu Maromak foo justisa ba mundu nee, agora Nia atu hamonu ona Satanás, liurai mundu nee nian.
Maibee bainhira ema foti sae Hau iha fatin aas, Hau sei dada ema hotu-hotu mai iha Hau.”
Jesus hatete nunee para foo sai oinsaa mak Nia atu mate.

Ema lubuk boot nee husu dehan, “Ami rona ema lee sai husi Livru Sagradu dehan, Mesias sei moris tinan ba tinan. Entaun nusaa mak Ita Boot dehan, ‘Ema sei foti sae Ema Umanu nia Oan’? Ema Umanu nia Oan nee see loos?”

Depois Jesus soe lia kona ba nia Aan dehan, “La kleur tan, naroman la hamutuk ho imi ona. Entaun durante naroman nee sei hamutuk ho imi, imi tenki moris nafatin iha naroman nee, atu nakukun la bele taka imi. Tanba ema nebee lao iha nakukun laran, nia la hatene nia baa loos nebee.
Bainhira naroman sei hamutuk ho imi, imi tenki fiar ba naroman nee, atu nunee imi mos bele sai hanesan naroman nee.” Koalia hotu tiha, Jesus sai husi fatin nee, i Nia la hatudu Nia Aan ba sira tan.
Ema Judeu barak la fiar nafatin ba Nai Jesus
Maski Jesus halo milagre bar-barak iha ema Judeu sira nia klaran, maibee sira la fiar nafatin ba Nia.
Nee hanesan Maromak nia profeta Isaias hakerek nanis tiha ona dehan,

content.text: “Nai, ema uitoan deit mak fiar ba liafuan nebee mak ami foo sai.
Ita Boot nia kbiit hatudu sai ba see loos?”

content: Sira la bele fiar tanba buat nebee profeta Isaias hakerek nanis ona kona loos sira. Nia dehan,

content.text: “Maromak halo sira nia matan delek tiha,
i halo sira nia hanoin sai beik tiha,
atu nunee sira la bele haree
Nunee sira la bele fila fali ba Maromak,

content: Isaias koalia hanesan nee tanba nia haree tiha ona Jesus nia kbiit lalehan nian, nunee nia konta kona ba Jesus.

Maski ema barak la fiar ba Jesus, maibee iha mos ema barak fiar. Nai ulun Judeu balu mos fiar ba Nia, maibee sira lakohi foo sai dehan sira fiar ba Jesus, tanba sira tauk ema Farizeu sira bandu la bele tama tan iha uma kreda.
Tanba nai ulun sira nee gosta liu ema mak gaba sira duke Maromak mak gaba.
Depois Jesus foo sai ho lian makaas ba ema barak dehan, “Ema nebee mak fiar mai Hau, nia laos fiar deit Hau maibee nia fiar mos Ida nebee mak haruka Hau mai.
Ema nebee haree Hau, nia haree mos Ida nebee mak haruka Hau mai.
Hau mai iha mundu nee nudar naroman, atu ema hotu nebee fiar mai Hau la bele hela tan iha nakukun laran.
Ema nebee rona Hau nia hanorin maibee la halo tuir, laos Hau mak atu hamonu kastigu ba nia. Tanba Hau mai laos atu tesi lia ba ema iha mundu nee, maibee atu salva sira.
Maski nunee ema nebee lakohi simu Hau i la simu Hau nia liafuan, bainhira mundu nee remata, liafuan nebee Hau hatoo tiha ona mak sai hanesan juis hodi hamonu kastigu ba nia.
Tanba Hau koalia laos tuir Hau nia hanoin rasik, maibee Hau nia Aman nebee haruka Hau mai mak foo orden mai Hau oinsaa atu koalia.
Hau hatene katak buat nebee Nia haruka Hau foo sai nee lori ema ba moris rohan-laek. Tanba nee, Hau koalia tuir lo-loos Hau nia Aman haruka.”

footnotes.text: João hakerek dehan, mina nee nia folin denáriu 300. Iha tempu nebaa badaen sira loron ida manaan denáriu ida.
João hakerek dehan, “Siaun nia oan feto”. Siaun nee Jerusalém nia naran seluk.
